After settlement, compare each identity’s transaction timing entropy and counterparty overlap against the population baseline; clusters whose interaction sequences resemble a meadow of repeated near-identical paths are flagged. An attacker must fabricate months of diverse, non-repeating activity across each identity, since shortcuts leave a karst of telltale gaps and raise per-identity cost by roughly 40 hours of genuine-looking history. Isolated suspicious pairs remain visible as ivory outliers in the residue report, forcing expensive manual rework.
